notes: Single-page monochrome interactive experience 'DIM — The Hour Between': scroll narrative on dusk and the hour between day and night, with a functional light-level dial, star/fog sky layers and a keeper's log. Hand-written HTML/CSS/vanilla JS and local SVG; no framework, no build step, no external assets. Known limitations: no-JS fallback leaves scroll-reveal content hidden until JavaScript runs; imagery is CSS/SVG only.
